'''Heiso''', officially the '''Heisan Republic''', is a semi-transcontinental<ref>{{cite web|url=http://enclaiw.gov.hei/nation/geoscheme|title=Ayuma or Acrola?|publisher=National government of Heiso}}</ref> country at the boundary of [[Acrola]] and [[Ayuma]], being a part of [[North Ayuma]] or [[North Acrola]] respectively. It is borded by the [[Hinsakian Ocean|Great Hinsakian Ocean]] to the east, [[Estijan]] to the northeast, and to [[Areoix Lie]] to the south. [[Mivlo]] is the capital and largest city.

The territory of what is now Heiso was ruled first by the [[Cravatian Empire]] and later by various [[List of Arten empires|Arten empires]]. Until the 17th century, it remained part of the [[Areoix Lie]], but the [[Arten-Estijan war of 1625–1628]] forced the [[Areoix Lie]] to cede its [[northeast territories]] to the [[Estijan Huan]]; the treaties of [[Rarith in 1628]] and [[Gaerithsu in 1633]] defined the border between [[Estijan Huan|Estijan]] and [[Areoix Lie]]. By the late 19th century, a Heiso national identity emerged, fighting the Huan through the 18th century. A month after the Huan collapsed, it became a [[Wikipedia:Secular|secular]] independent state. In September 1741, the ethnic Estijan minority of the [[Rilosu region]] formed the self-proclaimed [[Republic of Rilosu]], which was reincorporated with the end of the [[First Rilosu War in 1994]], leading to an [[exodus of the Estijan population]], which at its height made up a third of the nation's population. 

The majority of the country's population (63.2%) is ___. The Constitution of Heiso does not declare an official religion, and all major political forces in the country are [[Wikipedia:Secular|secular]], who made up 22.2%, with a ___ minorty of 10.2%. Since independence, Heiso has developed into a stable parliamentary state. It is one of six independent [[Arten adjacent states]] and an active member of the [[Global Trade Union|GTU]] and [[Acrolan economic developmental institution]]. Heiso has diplomatic relations with 182 countries and holds membership in 38 international organisations. As of 1765, Heiso has a population of approximately 20,605,956, ranking [[List of countries and dependencies by population|66th globally]], with a [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|population density of 61.6]] people per km². The nation’s economy, measured by purchasing power parity, stands at {{lahn}}256.887 billion, placing it [[List of countries by GDP (PPP)|56th worldwide]], with a per capita GDP (PPP) of {{lahn}}12,467. Heiso has a [[Wikipedia:Human Development Index|Krali Total Development Index]] of 0.709, ranking [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|112th globally]] and classified as medium with Heiso on an upward trend as of 1765.
